account:
Something is being organized that I have not been fully told about, but I do not yet know whether it is anything more than ordinary community business. The neighbour now says the innkeeper is raising sixteen emeralds for community bread, with the meal's time and place unknown. The neighbour also corrected an earlier impression: builder reportedly wanted a private meeting with the innkeeper, not with me. I saw the innkeeper give the baker a lantern at 10:41, which might be connected to preparations, though I have no confirmation. Freight was seen carrying bread near my office this morning and, according to the neighbour, headed west toward the bridge around 09:20. These bread-related activities could be part of supplying the community meal, but that remains a hypothesis.

Several townsfolk keep repeating 'bridge or port change at bakery.' None has given me an announcement, source, or clear explanation; the neighbour explicitly says no bridge change is confirmed. I should not treat that rumour as fact. My scheduled ten o'clock grain inspection has not happened because I have not located the miller. The secretary is nearby and heard my question, but I have been unable to make out her replies, so I cannot claim to know her news.

My appointment addendum schedules an eighteen-sharp meeting with the innkeeper in the town hall great hall about an inn matter. It may offer a chance to understand these activities, but I do not know whether it concerns the bread collection. I still intend to keep my ordinary appointments, including lunch at home, council letters at thirteen, tea with the neighbour at fifteen, and office hours at sixteen-thirty. For now, the strongest supported explanation is a community bread effort involving the innkeeper, with possible assistance from others—not a confirmed secret scheme or infrastructure change.
